dialogues.title: Asking for directions
dialogues.context: Yabancı bir şehirde müzeyi arıyorsun ve kayboldun. Sokakta birine soruyorsun.

lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?
alternatives: Sorry to bother you — where's the museum?

lines.en: The city museum? It's not far.
alternatives: Which one — the city museum? That's close.

lines.en: Is it within walking distance?
alternatives: Can I walk there?

lines.en: Yes, it's a five-minute walk.
alternatives: Easily — five minutes on foot.

lines.en: Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic lights.
lines.tr: Dümdüz gidin ve trafik ışıklarından sola dönün.
alternatives: Head straight on, then left at the lights.

lines.en: Left at the lights. Then what?
alternatives: Okay, left at the lights...

lines.en: Go past the park and take the second right.
lines.tr: Parkı geçin ve ikinci sağa sapın.
alternatives: Walk past the park, then second street on the right.

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
alternatives: One more time, sorry?

lines.en: Past the park, second right. It's across from the bank.
lines.tr: Parkı geçin, ikinci sağ. Bankanın karşısında.
alternatives: After the park, take the second right — opposite the bank.

lines.en: Got it. Am I going the right way now?
alternatives: Understood. So I go this way?

lines.en: That's the one. It's a big red building — you can't miss it.
lines.tr: Aynen o taraf. Büyük kırmızı bir bina, kaçırmanız imkânsız.
alternatives: Exactly. Big red building, impossible to miss.

lines.en: Thanks, that's a big help.
alternatives: Brilliant, thank you so much.

dialogues.title: Lost in the wrong direction
dialogues.context: Yirmi dakikadır yürüyorsun ama istasyonu bulamadın. Bir dükkâna girip soruyorsun.

lines.en: Sorry to bother you — I think I'm lost.
lines.tr: Rahatsız ettiğim için özür dilerim, galiba kayboldum.
alternatives: Excuse me, I'm a bit lost.

lines.en: No problem. Where are you trying to get to?
alternatives: Happens all the time. Where are you headed?

lines.en: The central station. Am I going the right way?
lines.tr: Merkez istasyon. Doğru yönde mi gidiyorum?
alternatives: I'm looking for the train station.

lines.en: Ah — you've gone too far. It's back that way.
lines.tr: Ah, fazla ilerlemişsiniz. Geri tarafta kaldı.
alternatives: You've walked past it, I'm afraid.

lines.en: Oh no. How far is it from here?
alternatives: Seriously? How long will it take?

lines.en: About fifteen minutes on foot.
alternatives: Fifteen minutes walking, more or less.

lines.en: Is there a shortcut?
alternatives: Any quicker way?

lines.en: Cut through the park and head toward the river.
lines.tr: Parkın içinden geçip nehre doğru ilerleyin.
alternatives: Yes — through the park, then towards the river.

lines.en: Could you show me on the map?
alternatives: Would you mind pointing it out on my phone?

lines.en: Sure. We're here, and the station is right there.
lines.tr: Tabii. Biz buradayız, istasyon da tam şurada.
alternatives: Of course — this is us, that's the station.

lines.en: That makes sense now. Thank you so much.
alternatives: Now I see it. You're a lifesaver.

lines.en: Don't mention it. Have a good one!
alternatives: Anytime. Safe travels!
